subject: Request: Sponsor-level promo credit + custom billing for LaunchLab cohort
messages:
From: Beth Nolan <beth@launchlab.org>
To: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>
Cc: LaunchLab Ops <partners@launchlab.org>
Date: Tue, 01 Jun 2027 09:15:00 -0700
Subject: LaunchLab cohort - sponsor ask (credits + billing)

Hi Ben —

Thanks again for taking the quick call yesterday. LaunchLab is finalizing the benefits package for our July founder cohort and we have a sponsor that wants Redwood to be listed as an official infrastructure sponsor. Before we sign anything they asked for two things: a pool of free credits they can distribute to cohort startups (roughly 60 startups, 18 weeks each) and a consolidated monthly invoice rather than cards on file for each startup.

What we're asking:
- 90k free generation tokens (can be split across startups; estimate ~1.5k per company)
- One sponsor billing arrangement (net30) so LaunchLab handles the billing back to startups

We're excited about promoting Redwood at the demo day and on our website; this would be a good visibility play. Can you confirm whether we can do a sponsor-level credits exception, and what the billing path looks like for V1?

I attached the sponsor agreement with the legal language the sponsor prefers (PDF).

Thanks — Beth
Beth Nolan
Programs Director, LaunchLab Accelerator
beth@launchlab.org

Attachment: LaunchLab_Sponsor_Agreement_v2.pdf (application/pdf)

From: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>
To: Beth Nolan <beth@launchlab.org>
Cc: Hannah Schmitt <hannah_schmitt@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 01 Jun 2027 11:03:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: LaunchLab cohort - sponsor ask (credits + billing)

Hi Beth —

Really appreciate the context and the visibility opportunity. Short answer: we can probably support a sponsor credits pool and a consolidated billing path, but I need to confirm limits and manager approval on the credit amount and net terms.

Proposed next steps from our side:
- I'll escalate to ops and our sales manager for a one-time promo credit exception.
- If approved, we usually cap sponsor pools and require a short MOU documenting redistribution rules and expiry (90 days after cohort start).
- For billing, we can enable sponsor invoicing (net30) as a one-off for LaunchLab with a single billing profile — will require legal to sign the sponsor agreement and Finance to enable net terms.

Can you share a rough timeline for when you need the agreement signed? Also attaching a simple cohort pricing table with options we normally use for accelerators — helps with scoping.

Best,
Ben Carter
Enterprise Partnerships, Redwood Inference
ben_carter@redwood.ai

Attachment: cohort_pricing_table.xlsx (application/vnd.openxmlformats-officedocument.spreadsheetml.sheet)

From: Hannah Schmitt <hannah_schmitt@redwood.ai>
To: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>, Markus Klein <markus_klein@redwood.ai>
Date: Wed, 02 Jun 2027 08:42:00 -07:00
Subject: Fwd: LaunchLab cohort - sponsor ask (credits + billing)

Ben / Markus —

Looping you in. LaunchLab is asking for 90k generation tokens and sponsor invoicing (net30). Notes:
- 90k tokens is above our usual accelerator playbook (typically 30–50k).
- Sponsor invoicing is doable but Finance needs a signed agreement and a one-time credit approval on the ledger.

My thoughts: we can do a hybrid approach to limit downside:
- Approve 60k sponsor credits now; allow an additional 30k to be released after cohort midpoint if usage metrics look healthy and PR commitments (logo + demo day shoutout) are confirmed.
- Require sponsor agreement signatures and a single point of contact for billing disputes.

Ben, can you draft the short MOU language and confirm whether we need a special SKU/discount code for the cohort startups? Markus, would you approve the staged-release approach for credits and net30 billing contingent on legal sign-off?

Thanks — Hannah
Hannah Schmitt
Head of Accelerator Programs, Redwood Inference

From: Markus Klein <markus_klein@redwood.ai>
To: Hannah Schmitt <hannah_schmitt@redwood.ai>, Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>
Date: Fri, 04 Jun 2027 10:12:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Fwd: LaunchLab cohort - sponsor ask (credits + billing)

Hannah / Ben —

I like the staged-release approach. Approve 60k credits up front with an automated review at week 9; authorize an additional 30k contingent on:
1) Cohort startups hitting the usage thresholds in the attached pricing table (high level metrics only),
2) Signed sponsor agreement with indemnity clause as drafted by Legal,
3) LaunchLab commits to the logo/PR package and a demo-day spot for Redwood.

Finance — please prepare the sponsor billing profile for LaunchLab with net30 and single invoice. Legal — push back only on any Sponsor indemnity changes; we want the agreement executed within 7 business days.

Ben — you can communicate this to Beth. Keep the wording tight (no open-ended credit promises).

-Markus
Markus Klein
Director, Sales Ops

From: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>
To: Beth Nolan <beth@launchlab.org>
Cc: Hannah Schmitt <hannah_schmitt@redwood.ai>, Markus Klein <markus_klein@redwood.ai>, LaunchLab Ops <partners@launchlab.org>
Date: Mon, 07 Jun 2027 16:42:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: LaunchLab cohort - sponsor ask (credits + billing)

Beth —

Great news: we can move forward. Summary of agreed terms from Redwood:
- Initial sponsor credit pool: 60,000 generation tokens to be distributed by LaunchLab to cohort startups at Redwood's promo rate.
- Conditional release: additional 30,000 tokens held in reserve and will be released at LaunchLab cohort midpoint (week 9) upon confirmation of usage trends and fulfillment of PR commitments.
- Billing: single monthly invoice to LaunchLab (net30) after legal signs sponsor agreement.
- Expiry: all sponsor credits expire 90 days after cohort start date.

Next steps for you: please return the signed Sponsor Agreement (we noted small redline in section 4 — payment timing) and confirm cohort start date. I attached a draft MOU clause below that we will add to the agreement to make the staged release explicit.

Draft MOU clause (for insertion):
"Redwood will issue an initial pool of 60,000 promotional generation tokens to LaunchLab for redistribution to cohort participants. An additional pool of 30,000 tokens will be reserved and released upon Redwood's review at cohort midpoint, contingent on usage thresholds and fulfillment of agreed promotional activities. All promotional tokens expire 90 days after cohort start date."

If this looks good, please return the signed agreement and we'll process the sponsor billing setup.

Best,
Ben Carter
Enterprise Partnerships, Redwood Inference
ben_carter@redwood.ai

Attachment: LaunchLab_Sponsor_Agreement_v2.pdf (updated)
